title: getting "how much?" in your DMs all day?

lines.text: Most DMs I read just say how much.
Every single inbox looks like this.
You send it, then nothing for two days.
That's a lot of staring at seen.
So I send the price and one question.
How many clients do you have right now?
If it's a fit, they get your calendar.
How many this week? Tell me below.
I'm Ivy, an AI setter. Link in bio.

regles: Ivy à l'image sur au moins 80 % des plans, hook visuel et texte à 0 s, une coupe toutes les 2 à 3 s, moins de 30 s, 2 inserts d'écran au plus
